decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly rebranded version of a proven, well-liked trommel screen that fits the firm's core screening business, so sunk investment and visible commitment argue strongly for keeping it.

The green-waste grinder line serves core composting and biomass customers, and management that already cut three lines would rather defend this multi-model investment and blame weak visibility on temporary market conditions than admit another failure.

The stationary pre-shredder line had its own page and is central to the announced push into tougher stationary processing, so the firm's commitment justifies persisting even though recent evidence on it is missing.
